delivery_policy.cadence: Plan every tenth counted completion as GitHub-only; exclude dry runs and reconcile actual totals before ideation.
delivery_policy.github_only_standard: Complete useful native/CLI/library/engine/backend workflow, clean-environment setup, meaningful tests and input-to-output execution evidence, rerun/recovery checks, complete README and source push.
delivery_policy.portfolio_policy: All three entries after applicable checks pass. Code-only label and source/walkthrough links for GitHub-only entries; no live URL or deployment claim.

domain_depth_policy.requirement: Substantial connected functionality beyond the main advanced core workflow; verify real state transitions and complete outcomes. Cosmetic screens or code length do not qualify.

technology_policy.new_technology_absence_baseline: Current verified resume and supplied/accessible profile
technology_policy.current_demand_verification: Fresh primary hiring or employer engineering sources before future selection; dated private evidence, no unsupported demand claims.
technology_policy.rotation: Track substantive resume-skill coverage and new core technologies across runs; use relevant available skills when useful.

priority_families: AI retrieval, orchestration, evaluation and tracing
ML training, mathematical internals and inference optimization
Financial execution and exact usage accounting
Founder infrastructure, workflow products and lawful distribution
engineering_depth_policy.selection: Choose the strongest three distinct concepts and industries autonomously; rotate families, cores and stacks across the collection
depth_gate: Substantive custom core and explicit invariants
Complete usable workflow and realistic persistence/failure semantics
Independent correctness/reference oracles or appropriate evaluations
Reproducible benchmarks and named baseline where relevant
Honest runtime/hardware boundaries; no invented performance or customer claims
engineering_depth_policy.orchestration_tools: LangChain and LangGraph are eligible when they materially serve the workflow; meaningful core integration and evaluation required
